capabilities: Add a Show backlinks entry to link context menus in source mode, Live Preview, properties, and reading mode
Open a temporary Bases view filtered by file.hasLink() to the clicked target
Reuse and customize a single _backlinks.base file across searches
Reset the base view by deleting _backlinks.base
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.12+ on desktop and mobile; not yet in the community directory, so BRAT is the suggested install path.
intentEvidence: opening a temporary Bases view filtered to show all notes that link to that target
problem: Obsidian's backlinks view shows links for the currently open note, but there is no quick way to see backlinks for an arbitrary link target from its context menu.

relations.evidence: Install Obsidian42 - BRAT from the Community Plugins directory.

summary: Adds a right-click 'Show backlinks' menu entry that opens a temporary Bases view filtered to all notes linking to the clicked target.
